title: Chapter 239
text:
In his previous life, Han Xiao already knew about Cyberlos.

He was one of the higher-ups of the Germinal Organization, and he was the one who turned Aurora into Aurora Sauce. That was how he became known to the players. Cyberlos had no integrity and would betray any organization for the sake of his life. To him, he could only do more experiments as long as he was alive. The so-called loyalty was bullsh * t in his eyes.

If he were to threaten him, Han Xiao was very confident that Cyberlos would obediently compromise for his life. Of course, that was under the condition that no one else found out.

However, there was a small problem. The headquarters was huge, and Han Xiao did not know where Cyberlos was.

At this time, a player with an ID floating above his head walked over. Han Xiaoxin's heart moved.

There are also players in the underground headquarters. I can try using them.

Just as Elux was about to submit a daily training mission, a Germinal Organization soldier suddenly appeared in front of him and stopped him. He looked ferocious, but he had a kind smile like a crocodile grinning. This unlucky guy that Han Xiao replaced looked too boorish.

Elux's butt tightened, and he trembled. "You — what do you want?"

Han Xiao laughed, but it made Elux's heart turn cold. He paused and said, "Little brother, I have a small matter that requires your help." He then set up an unsigned mission and sent it out. The request was to find out Cyberlos' location. He pretended that he had an urgent matter to report in the mission introduction as if it was real. Because the players would not doubt the description of the mission introduction, they would not be suspicious at all.

Elux was surprised. This was the first time he had seen a mission that came to him on its own accord. The reward was quite good, and he was tempted. Furthermore, it was very easy to find Cyberlos. He could only be in the laboratory.

"Okay, I'll be back soon." Elux went to confirm.

Not long after, Han Xiao received the news that Cyberlos was checking the data on the laboratory floor.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled, and he gave Elux another mission, asking him to get the floor map of the headquarters. It was not easy for him to get such a thing himself, but the players who worked in the headquarters would know about it. Elux did not suspect anything. He had a map on him, so he passed it to Han Xiao.

After reading it carefully, Han Xiao nodded to himself. He had a plan for the next step.

The lab floor took up a lot of space. Han Xiao sneaked to the resting station of the researchers and blocked the camera in the corner with his Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades. He quickly opened a box in the changing room and took out a few white coats and masks. He disguised himself as one of the researchers and walked to the lab floor.

At this time, Cyberlos was in a large laboratory, commanding the white coats to adjust the functions of a new batch of super soldiers. He was browsing the data on the computer. Seeing that there were many people here, Han Xiao adjusted his mask and approached Cyberlos quietly. He flipped his hand and took out a simple detector. He scanned Cyberlos roughly, and the result was that there were no bugs. This result was within his expectations. Cyberlos stayed in the headquarters all year round and did not have a strong sense of security. He also did not have guards around him.

Han Xiao turned his back to Cyberlos and pretended to organize the data on the table. He curled his finger, and a sharp blade entered Cyberlos' coat and stuck to his heart.

Cyberlos felt a chill in his heart. He quickly reached out and felt a thin metal object through his coat. He was shocked and wanted to pull open his collar to take a look. At this time, he heard a low voice clearly despite the noise around him.

"Quiet, don't move, and don't scream. Otherwise, this blade will cut open your heart. Now, pretend that nothing happened and listen to my orders. If you don't, die. If you trigger the alarm, die."

Cyberlos looked around and saw that everyone was an enemy. He said in a low voice, "Don't be impulsive. What do you want me to do?" For the sake of his life, he did not dare to resist.

"Leave the lab and don't make a sound."

"Okay, okay, don't do anything." Cyberlos took a few deep breaths and said loudly, "You guys continue with the experiment. I have something to do."

Then, he walked toward the door. The other researchers did not suspect anything. Han Xiao paused and followed behind Cyberlos.

The two of them came to the corridor. Cyberlos saw Han Xiao behind him and knew that this was the person who held him hostage. He looked at him carefully and said in a low voice, "What do you want me to do?"

"Bring me to the mainframe. Don't play any tricks. I need your permission. If anything happens, I can pierce your heart in 0.01 seconds," Han Xiao said.

"I won't." Cyberlos felt the cold metal in his heart, calmed himself down, and led the way. He was not a warrior, and his life was more important than anything else. He knew that he could only compromise. He had no other choice and was not willing to take the risk of triggering the alarm.

Along the way, they met many Germinal Organization members. Cyberlos acted naturally and nodded as usual. Han Xiao followed closely behind. Others thought that he was Cyberlos' assistant, and no one suspected anything.

After walking into a deserted corridor, Cyberlos carefully looked at Han Xiao's face and suddenly said in a low voice, "You're in disguise, Zero."

Han Xiaoxin was shocked. How did he know my identity?

Cyberlos continued, "In order to catch you, the leader set up a trap in the headquarters. Countless executives were on standby. You really did sneak in …"

Han Xiao's expression changed slightly. He felt that something was wrong. The leader set up an ambush in advance and waited for him. Did that mean that he knew that he would sneak in?

How is that possible?

He did not tell anyone about his actions!

Could it be that the leader has an Esper who can predict the future? Then, am I surrounded now?

For a moment, Han Xiaoxin was confused. He quickly calmed himself down and felt that something was wrong. If the leader really knew his target, how could he sneak into the headquarters so easily? This meant that the leader's knowledge was limited. He did not even know how he could sneak in by changing his face, so he did not take precautions.

Han Xiao immediately thought of the gap in the Germinal Organization's deployment and confirmed that this was a trap set by the Germinal Organization.

Too many questions appeared in his mind. Since Cyberlos took the initiative to ask, Han Xiao knew what he meant. He suppressed the murderous intent in his heart and said in a deep voice, "Tell me everything you know, and I'll consider letting you live."

Cyberlos felt the murderous intent, and his back was wet with cold sweat. He forced himself to calm down and said, "This is all the prediction of Destiny's Child."

Destiny's Child? Han Xiao frowned. He did not know that there was such a person in the Germinal Organization.

"Destiny's Child's ability may be to predict the future, or it may be to decide the future. We are not sure. He predicted that you would walk into the trap …" Cyberlos explained everything from the beginning. Destiny's Child's ability, his prediction of Han Xiao, the leader's deployment, he did not hide anything. For his own life, he would say anything.

The Germinal Organization is hiding such a person. Han Xiao was shocked. There was no information about this person in his previous life. It seemed that this was the Germinal Organization's deepest secret. If Destiny's Child's ability was to affect the future, did that mean that his idea of saving people was forced by someone else?

Suddenly, his murderous intent rose.

The mind was a person's private space. If it was invaded, it would definitely cross anyone's bottom line.

There were many abilities that could affect the mind, such as psychic power, magic, and superpowers. Even in the universe, there were natural phenomena that had similar effects. For example, the Psychic Current was the amalgamation of thoughts, forming a wave band on the mental level, traveling in an invisible form in the universe. Wherever it passed, living beings with thoughts would hear the 'voice' of the Psychic Current in their mind, and their thoughts would be affected.

However, Han Xiao thought that this guess was too unbelievable. More than a year ago, when he saw Hella, he already had the idea of saving people. Furthermore, he had also analyzed the benefits of doing so. It was all from the perspective of benefits, and he would not be affected at all. Furthermore, he chose to sneak into the Germinal Organization headquarters not only to save people but also for other reasons.

Destiny's Child's ability had to be limited, or at least its effect on him was limited. However, he had accurately predicted that he would come to the Germinal Organization headquarters alone. This made Han Xiao feel relieved, but at the same time, he was also a little worried.

He finally understood how scary it was to have an enemy who seemed to be able to predict the future. He immediately understood why the leader was so annoyed.

"I've damaged the Germinal Organization greatly. I'm afraid the leader wants to skin me alive and pull out my muscles."

From what Cyberlos said, Han Xiao understood that there were a large number of executive officers and troops hidden in the headquarters, waiting to deal with him. Once there was any movement, they could surround him at any time. He was in a very bad situation.

However, Han Xiao also realized that he had a huge advantage. That was, the leader only knew that he would come, but did not know the exact time or his exact goal.

Then, I still have an advantage. I can't drag this out any longer. It's best to leave immediately after completing the goal. Han Xiaoxin was very serious.

If he could complete the mission and leave without anyone knowing, that would be the best result.
